Unnamed Package

  • Class
    Description
    Aesthetic
    Provides ANSI escape code constants for coloring and formatting terminal output.
    Assessment
    The Assessment class serves as an abstract superclass for evaluating orbit and collision risks of space objects.
    CollisionTXT
    The CollisionTXT class reads collision risk data from a CSV file and generates a TXT report summarizing object types and their associated risk levels.
    CountObjects
    The CountObjects class provides static methods to analyze the impact of space object launches from CSV data.
    DensityAnalysis
    The DensityAnalysis class provides functionality to analyze space object density data from a CSV file.
    ExtendedUserMenu
    The ExtendedUserMenu class provides the menu-driven interface for scientists to perform actions related to tracking space objects based on object type or orbit type.
    FileParser
    Utility class for parsing CSV lines, including handling quoted fields and embedded commas.
    GenerateCSVFiles
    The GenerateCSVFiles class is responsible for generating output CSV files containing orbit status and collision risk assessments for space objects.
    GenerateTXT
    The GenerateTXT interface defines a contract for classes that implement functionality to generate a TXT file based on input data.
    ImpactAnalysis
    The ImpactAnalysis class analyzes the impact of space object collisions based on different modes specified by the user.
    MainMenu
    The MainMenu class handles user interaction at the main menu level.
    OpenFolder
    Provides a graphical file chooser to allow users to select a file from the "CSV" directory.
    OrbitTXT
    The OrbitTXT class implements the GenerateTXT interface to generate a plain text summary report of orbit status based on CSV input data.
    PrintToTerminal
    Prints CSV file contents to the terminal, filtering by user type.
    ReadFile
    Handles reading, parsing, and displaying data from CSV files for space object tracking and analysis.
    RunSimulation
    Entry point of the space object tracking simulation.
    ScannerClass
    Provides a single shared Scanner instance for reading input from System.in.
    SignInVerification
    Provides user sign-in verification by validating credentials against a CSV file.
    SpaceObject
    The SpaceObject class represents a general object in space, such as debris, satellites, rocket bodies, or unknown objects.
    SystemLogger
    The SystemLog class provides a utility for logging messages to a persistent log file with timestamped entries.
    User
    Represents a user in the system with basic attributes.
    UserCreation
    Handles the creation of new users and appends them to the CSV file ("User-List.csv").
    UserDeletion
    The UserDeletion class handles the process of deleting a user from a CSV file ("User-List.csv") based on user type and user ID.
    UserManagement
    Handles editing of existing users stored in a CSV file ("User-List.csv").
    UserMenu
    The SubMenu class handles user interactions for submenus after the main menu login.
